decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - Reasons:
The London Borough of Hounslow as the Local Planning Authority hereby certify that on 07/09/05 the use of plots 15 and 30, and the metal awning on plot 15, on the Bedfont Trading Estate, Bedfont Road for the repair and storage of lorries was lawful within the meaning of Section 191 and 192 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 for the following reason:
The use of the premises began more than ten years ago and has continued since then.
description: Certificate of lawfulness for the existing plots comprising two yards of approximately 125 sq m  and approximately 210 sq m and a metal awning on plot 15 of approximately 30 sq m (but excluding a portakabin that is currently on plot 15) used for the storage and repair of lorries.
